purpose: Teach: 役に立ち/即時/役場/強固/着信/インセンティブ/力量/上京

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 新人研修、社員に、役に立ちましたよね、評価、高かったわよ、皆から。
lines.en: The new staff training program was really valuable, and the evaluations came back quite positive across the board.
lines.style: Clear, affirming tone. Measured pace. Slight pause after 'valuable' to let the good news land. Professional but genuinely pleased.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。顧客対応、即時、行うよう、コールセンター、徹底しています。
lines.en: Yes. We've made sure the call center team responds to customer inquiries immediately.
lines.style: Earnest agreement. Crisp delivery on 'immediately.' Sits forward slightly—showing he's engaged in the details. Warm but focused.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 市役所、地域の役場、連携を、強めていきましょう、いつも。
lines.en: We should keep building stronger partnerships with the city hall and local government offices.
lines.style: Directive but not commanding. Soft emphasis on 'building.' Open-ended rhythm—inviting alignment rather than demanding it. Thoughtful pace.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内のセキュリティ、強固な体制、構築しております、最新規格で。
lines.en: Yes. We're constructing a solid security infrastructure internally, using the latest standards.
lines.style: Steady, technical confidence. No rush. Light pride on 'solid.' Professional tone—reporting progress without overselling.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 業務携帯の着信音、社員が、気づきやすい音、選びましょうね。
lines.en: Let's make sure we pick a business phone ringtone that staff will actually notice.
lines.style: Gentle suggestion rather than order. Slight smile in the voice. Practical concern expressed with warmth, not fussiness.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。インセンティブ制度、若手のモチベーション、上げる工夫、必要です。
lines.en: Yes. We should think about incentive systems that will motivate the younger staff members.
lines.style: Engaged, problem-solving tone. Leans on 'should think'—inviting shared responsibility. Warm and collaborative, not lecturing.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 新任のチームリーダー、力量、見極めながら、配置していきましょう。
lines.en: As we assign the new team leaders, let's evaluate their capabilities carefully as we go.
lines.style: Measured, deliberate pacing. Slight emphasis on 'carefully.' Calm authority—thoughtful stewardship, not rushing judgment. Open to input.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。地方出身者、上京してから、馴染むまで、サポート、必要ですね。
lines.en: Yes. Staff who've relocated from outside Tokyo need support as they settle in.
lines.style: Quiet recognition of a human reality. Gentle firmness—this matters. No hurry in the delivery. Genuine empathy beneath the professional frame.
